metaDescription: Pharaoh Hound vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Pharaoh Hound boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Pharaoh Hound social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Pharaoh Hound exposure.
Weight range 45-55 lb (20-25 kg) and grooming needs (Short coat; blushes when excited.) belong in the same Pharaoh Hound household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Pharaoh Hound is also monitored for demodex risk, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Pharaoh Hound appointments.
After the Pharaoh Hound puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Pharaoh Hound misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Pharaoh Hound series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Pharaoh Hound is the gap, not the embarrassment, because parvovirus pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated puppy even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up DA2PP / DHPP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Pharaoh Hound away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Pharaoh Hound due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Pharaoh Hound core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Pharaoh Hound misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Pharaoh Hound health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Pharaoh Hound adult health guide for breed predispositions such as allergies, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
